links.comparator_used: Documentation (summary) quality ratings alone, without direct measurement of the conversation
links.outcome: Detection of conversational gaps in chatbot history-taking (critical elements asked about and addressed)
links.effect: Standardized-patient full-conversation measurement detected lower coverage in Difficult vs Easy variants: asked 50.2% vs 59.3% (adjusted OR 1.49; 95% CI, 1.15 to 1.93); addressed 64.6% vs 73.3% (OR 1.47; 1.12 to 1.93). Near-ceiling summary quality did not differ between variants.
links.tradeoff: Reviewer agreement was moderate to substantial for element judgments (AC1 0.49 to 0.70) but poor for totals (ICC 0.10 and 0.21). The method needed SP encounters (80 chatbot encounters) plus blinded clinician transcript review. It was piloted pre-clinically, not as repeated post-deployment monitoring.
links.quote: Documentation ratings alone may miss conversational gaps, which require direct measurement.
